shuttle: Delegate shuttle buses depart ICC main entrance every 30 minutes (7:30 AM-9:00 PM) for partner hotels on the Damboa Road corridor.
parking: On-site parking at ICC with security. Follow marshals at the main gate. VIP drop-off at the lobby canopy.
directions: From Maiduguri Airport: ~45 min via Airport Road → Baga Road → ICC.
From city centre: Head east on Baga Road; ICC is signed from Damboa Road junction.
Conference registration opens 7:00 AM daily at Main Lobby.
